title: Davinci the Dualist: the mind-body divide in large language models and in human learners
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'Dualist bias' in LLMs and humans, specifically exploring metaphysical and epistemological questions regarding the mind-body divide. It includes Study 3 which evaluates beliefs about the 'afterlife' (religion/faith) and uses psychological traits such as 'distinguishing between right and wrong' (ethics/morals). It also deals extensively with the 'epistemic states' of the models, which relates to epistemology.
